title: aespa Kicks Off SYNK : COMPLæXITY Tour in Seoul: 6 Best Moments
summary: aespa opened its fourth world tour at with 27 songs, an expanded universe and a show that brought the group's many sides into full view.
contentText:
Seoul was already deep in the heat of August when thousands of MYs made their way to Gocheok Sky Dome for the opening weekend of aespa ‘s fourth world tour. Inside, the temperature only seemed to rise.

Across Aug. 7 and 8, Karina, Winter, Giselle and Ningning welcomed a combined 35,000 fans to aespa’s first concerts at the dome, opening SYNK : COMPLæXITY with 27 songs across roughly two-and-a-half hours. Built around “CRACK,” a rupture that brings aespa into conflict with altered versions of ae-aespa, the show unfolds through five chapters: singularity, intrusion, confinement, awakening and resolution. New songs from LEMONADE , which debuted at No. 9 on the Billboard 200 in June as the group’s third top 10 entry on the chart, sit alongside defining hits, solo and unit stages, cinematic VCRs and large-scale choreography.

Nearly six years into their career, aespa has become fluent in its own contrasts: hard-edged pop against unexpected sweetness, four distinct personalities moving in and out of formation, and a digital world of glitches, doubles and fractured realities that now feels closely tied to the music itself. SYNK : COMPLæXITY draws on all of those elements at once, but the Seoul show was most effective when they played off one another rather than simply adding to its scale.

For longtime MYs, the Seoul kickoff opened another chapter in a familiar world. For those waiting for aespa to arrive in their city, it offered a first look at how the group is carrying that language into its fourth world tour.

Here are the moments that stood out.
